neighbours.label: The word-internal piece 'arm' after Sh- or Y- in names (Sh-arm el Sheikh, Sh-arm-ila, Y-arm-outh, Y-arm-uk, Ś-arm-ā)
fire: Every winter my parents fly to Sharm el Sheikh for the sun.
The fishing boats returned to Great Yarmouth before the storm.
The actress Sharmila Tagore starred in many films in the 1960s.
The Yarmouk River flows into the Jordan valley.
Andriy Yarmolenko scored a late goal for Ukraine.
We stayed near the beach in Sharm, which is popular with divers.
A ferry left Yarmouth harbour at dawn.
The scholar Rāma Śarmā edited the Sanskrit text.
quiet: Every winter my parents fly to Hurghada for the sun.
The fishing boats returned to Lowestoft before the storm.
The actress Madhubala starred in many films in the 1950s.
The Litani River flows into the sea near Tyre.
Andriy Shevchenko scored a late goal for Ukraine.
We stayed near the beach in Dahab, which is popular with divers.
A ferry left Dover harbour at dawn.
The scholar broke his arm while carrying the Sanskrit texts.

notes: Probe: Sh-arm el Sheikh 0.91, Y-arm-uk 0.55, M-arm-aris 0.37 (peak on 'aris'), B-arm-outh 0.23, but D-arm-stadt 0.003; whole tokens ' farm' / ' arm' ~0.01. So the label is limited to Sh-/Y- onsets. I checked the tokenizer for every fire word (the 'arm' piece is its own token).
